description: Deterministic synchronization receipt emitted to stdout and optionally to an ignored/private artifact path. A separately sanitized projection may be tracked when a consumer explicitly requires durable public evidence.
sanitized_tracking_rules: A tracked/public projection must remove provider_revision, provider_change_token, local_scratch_path, and any raw locator/account identity.
provider_locator_fingerprint may be retained only when it is a one-way fingerprint that cannot be used as the provider locator.
state must not be promoted to SYNCED until the provider-side write and read-back verification both succeed when mutation is requested.
A blocked or failed sync does not disable future checkpoint or periodic attempts.
